classification.ownership: no repository writes; inspect only the declared paths
classification.domain_risk: low; textual inventory only, no product or trading decision
classification.independence: fresh bootstrap run; independent Terra verification required

delegation_brief.task: Produce a deterministic read-only inventory of active D-07 historical and alias references. Inspect only apps, packages, scripts, docs, run-bot, search-best-config, .github, package.json, turbo.json, and lefthook.yml. Do not inspect .git, data, temp, coverage, dist, node_modules, plans, or the sensitive-marker exclusions below. Do not modify any file.

preflight_facts.permission_mode: agy plan mode via relay --read-only with --sandbox

delegation_brief.required_output: For every pattern, report the exact total match count, exact file count, and a sorted path:line:text list. Separately report whether the bin, run-bot, search-best-config, and docs/legacy paths exist. Classify each match only by its path-derived area: production source, test, script/tooling, active docs, configuration, manifest/CI, or excluded. Do not recommend replacements, deletions, names, package moves, architecture, business behaviour, or trading behaviour. Do not claim completeness across the 24 excluded files.

prohibitions.item: No file writes, edits, generated files, staging, commits, or Git mutation.
No network, browser, plugin, MCP, credential, exchange, or external-provider access.
No business, financial, trading, code-organization, architecture, or module-boundary decision.
No opening or searching the 24 sensitive-marker exclusion files.
No private data, secret-shaped value, environment value, or file content outside matched lines in the final report.

delegation_brief.verification_loop: Confirm the working tree status row count and SHA-256 are unchanged after the inventory. Confirm no file was touched. If a required command is denied, ambiguous, or unsupported, stop and report the exact blocker; do not seek a workaround and do not broaden permissions.
delegation_brief.structured_output_contract: End with: (1) status completed or blocked, (2) requested model/effort and observable execution facts, (3) exact commands used, (4) per-pattern counts and sorted matches, (5) path existence results, (6) excluded-file count, (7) pre/post status count and SHA, (8) deviations or missing evidence.
